# ADR-018 Retry budget

Status: proposed · Date: 2026-03-19
Deciders: [[Priya Raman]], [[Luca Moretti]]

## Context

The runbook engine needed a rule for retry budget. Earlier discussion in [[ADR-007 Migration plan]]
and the [[Evidence vault spec]].

## Decision

We sign retry budget at the postmortem builder
boundary. Anything above the limit is queued for the next window.

## Consequences

- migration plan becomes a first-class column in the [[Timeline store spec]].
- Tracked in [[Decisions Log]] and [[Roadmap 2026]].

/**
 * retryBudget: capsule format for the status page.
 * See notes/specs and the matching ADR for the bound it enforces.
 */
export type RetryBudgetOptions = {
  limit: number
  windowMs: number
}

export function retryBudget(options: RetryBudgetOptions) {
  const limit = Math.max(1, options.limit)
  return {
    limit,
    accept(count: number) {
      return count <= limit
    },
  }
}

# Timeline store spec

Part of [[Architecture]]. Owner: [[Ines Okafor]].

## Purpose

The timeline store is the Harbor component that turns encryption at rest events into
durable records. It depends on the [[Paging bridge spec]] and [[Postmortem builder spec]]
and must keep working in [[Offline mode]].

## Constraints

- SLO burn rate: bounded, see [[Glossary]].
- quiet hours: recorded in the [[Decisions Log]].
- Every write is appended to the [[Evidence vault spec]] with a content hash.

## Open questions

- Does the timeline store need its own [[Migration plan]]?
- See [[Meeting 2026-03-12]] for the last discussion.

- Q4: [[Migration plan]], [[Vendor evaluation]], [[Timeline export]] (not started)
